spec: wiki Methods/'Method - Deep feedforward PC-ALM and belief-credit separation plan' (E2/E3), 2026-10-19
model: generative predictor of pred_gpc.py (residual top-down maps, widths 600 / 256 at depths 3 / 10), 4000 steps, batch 256, k in {1,2,3} seen views

stage1_belief.pc: plain-PC relaxation of the joint energy, hidden precision 1, T = 400, c = stage-1 selected PC c
stage1_belief.oracle: BP auto-decoder inference of s, T = 400, c = stage-1 selected BP c (backprop for inference only)
stage1_belief.amort: one pass of the amortiser, mean over seen views; trained locally toward s - eta_s * dL/ds (PC-ALM feedforward rule, alpha as the arm)

rule_sep.stage2_credit: all 4 views, s fixed, hidden levels start at topdown(s) (zero hidden residuals), lam = 0; T2 = 200 primal steps, dual step lam += r every k_in steps; penalty rho = hidden precision; activity step scale c
rule_sep.weights: gradient of the augmented energy at the final stage-2 state

selection: per depth, arm A1 (oracle + PC-ALM), seed 0, 90/10 train split, FULL 4000 steps: rho {4, 16} x k_in {1, 5}, c = 1 (halved on divergence, recorded); lowest held-out k=1 nmse; used for every PC arm at that depth
reference: frozen BP auto-decoder G1 (3 seeds; d3 0.3053, d10 0.2783). No new BP arm (user decision: BP gets none of PC's modifications).

readings.credit_at_depth: if A1 at d10 is stable and within 0.01 of G1, the C2 collapse came from coupling belief and multipliers; if A1 collapses, the multipliers fail at depth
readings.belief_cost: B1 - A1 (PC's belief), C1 - A1 (one-pass belief)
readings.classes: |delta| < 0.01 no detectable effect; 0.01-0.03 candidate (seeds 1, 2 in a later job); > 0.03 or failure reportable at screen level
readings.stability: res_rel and cos to the BP auto-decoder gradient at the same s, logged every 250 steps; a growing res_rel is reported as unstable

scope: seed 0 screen; 'oracle' isolates credit and is not a local method
